ns2:section.sectionText: Prerequisite: STAT 100, STAT 107 or permission of instructor. Data analysis and visualization have become integral parts of journalism. This class will introduce you to the basics of storytelling with data, including: finding and downloading data, using spreadsheets and database manager software, and presenting data in a way that helps us explore, identify and communicate patterns. Students will work with local and national data and learn how to combine their data analysis with interviews and field work to produce meaningful stories. Students will learn about various design principles and narrative forms to tell a data story in an effective, engaging and accessible way. Basic programming skill is preferred, as course materials are built on Python and Jupyter Notebook. Please note: Credit will not be given if you took JOUR 460 34802/34806 in SP20, as the course content is the same. Please note: This section will have synchronous (live) sessions. *Eligible for PR minor. https://media.illinois.edu/pr_minor
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Junior, Senior, or Graduate class standing.
